# sunao

> sunao is a Spotify-like music player built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, and Supabase. It plays 30-second previews from the iTunes Search API, shows album artwork from the iTunes CDN, and supports playlists, search, a virtualized queue, and playback speed control. It runs with or without a Supabase backend (static seed data fallback).

## What it is

- A web-based music player with a red/dark UI, inspired by Spotify.
- Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui on Base UI, Zustand, TanStack Query + Virtual, Supabase (optional), Zod.
- Audio: 30-second previews from the iTunes Search API (no key required), cached per title + artist, falling back to a bundled sample tone.
- Artwork: iTunes CDN, served through next/image.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Search: /search
- Library: /library
- Playlist detail: /playlist/{id}
- Sign in: /login
- Sign up: /signup
- About / FAQ: /about

## Features

- Play / pause, previous / next, auto-advance
- Seek scrubber bound to the audio element's real duration
- Playback speed: 0.5x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x
- Like / unlike the current track (session-only)
- Buffering spinner (debounced 200ms)
- Collapsible queue panel (desktop), bottom sheet (mobile)
- Auth (Supabase, optional): email/password sign in and sign up
- Mobile bottom nav, safe-area padding
